content: Spouses married in 1971 under statutory community property regime, divorced 1994. Husband sought dissolution of joint ownership of residential property in Jesolo purchased during marriage. Presidential order of November 2017 revoked prior assignment of marital home to wife. Articles 177, 191, 720 Italian Civil Code govern purchases during marriage, dissolution upon final divorce, and sale of indivisible property. The issue concerned timing for dissolution action and proper remedy for indivisible property. Application for dissolution admissible after final divorce ruling, which transforms legal community into ordinary joint ownership based on shares. Property purchased during marriage (1977) fell within legal community, entitling each spouse to 50% upon divorce finalization. Court-appointed expert confirmed property indivisible as single residential unit with garage. Absent assignment request from either party, Article 720 requires auction sale with proceeds divided equally. Property valued at €85,800.00 by expert. Costs and expert fees reserved for final judgment following sale.
